verdict.rationale: Google Workspace Context-Aware Access lets admins create granular, per-app security policies based on user identity, location, device security status, and IP address (docs-28/15). Community reports confirm it is used in practice, including device-posture enforcement through Endpoint Verification, though admins complain that troubleshooting is painful because the denial page does not say which policy blocked access. missing for 10: documented risk-signal inputs, explicit per-group policy assignment for CAA, and policy-debugging visibility.
